summary: The active diagnostics readout source-contract matcher strips only ordinary line comments before token searches. Required executable readout predicates can therefore be removed while equivalent text remains inside inert long comments, long-bracket strings, quoted strings, or backtick strings and still false-pass the matcher. Expected-red visibility PR #474 inherits the same proof weakness.
evidence: PR #468 exact head 0703a44ff68a96d5907d514f66480ac8aca0145a tests/physics_lab_diagnostics_readout_contract.luau builds its searchable source with string.gsub(rawSource, "%-%-[^\n]*", ""), removing only ordinary line comments.

The same matcher then uses string.find/token searches for exact Adornee, exact text, shape/count, and other readout invariants without masking long comments, long-bracket strings, quoted strings, or backtick strings.

Expected-red PR #474 head de4c4c778faebba8116000819c83dbfa1aa3db1a adds BillboardGui.Enabled and TextLabel.Visible source checks from that same line-comment-only source string, so its semantic visibility regression can also false-pass inert helper text after absorption.

The active diagnostics enabled-integrity regression already contains stronger inert-source masking for a different helper, proving the repository has encountered and hardened this source-contract false-pass class before; that protection does not cover the readout matcher.
Repository PR/issue searches for physics_lab_diagnostics_readout_contract inert-text or matcher-hardening ownership returned no dedicated existing repair.

Draft docs-only PR #487 exact head 577c350de48e9b62cc1ff1ca37bdb4a795245948 records the finding; no production, Studio, viewport, networking, persistence, physics-contact, or two-client behavior is changed or claimed.

metadata.recommendedNext: When the active diagnostics successor absorbs #474, harden physics_lab_diagnostics_readout_contract.luau to mask all inert Luau text and add long-comment/long-bracket/quoted/backtick false-pass mutants. Keep this source/test repair separate from live viewport acceptance.
